assumptions: Released POs are counted where PO Status equals Printed and both PM Approve Date and Buyer Approve Date are present.
Delay aging is calculated from Requisition PM Approve Date to Requisition Buyer Approve Date. PO Date is used only for monthly grouping.
Business hours exclude weekends and the region-specific 2026 holiday list. Same Day means business hours are less than 24; delay days equal full 24-hour business periods.
Weekend rules used: USA/Canada/Dubai exclude Saturday and Sunday; Saudi excludes Friday and Saturday.
PO amount totals are reported-value sums from the source files and are not converted between currencies.
USA PR total counts source rows where PO # is populated, regardless of PO Status. Average per day equals PR total divided by total business days shown in the monthly trend.
The delayed PO detail section lists Printed POs with a buyer approval delay of 1 or more business days, calculated from Requisition PM Approve Date to Requisition Buyer Approve Date.
Process timing metrics use calendar elapsed days for Printed POs with Requisition Create Date, Requisition PM Approve Date, and Requisition Buyer Approve Date populated.
exchangeRatesToUSD was populated with public monthly average rates and fixed-peg rates; use SEL Finance-approved rates if required for official reporting.
Daily drilldown counts rows where PO # is populated. Daily grouping uses PO Date when populated, otherwise Requisition Create Date as fallback.
